introduce: Stand in front of a wall one big step away from it. Then put your hands out straight towards the wall and lean against it. Lift your heels.\n\nSlowly bend your elbows and press your upper body towards the wall. Push back and repeat the exercise. Remember to keep your body straight.
name: WALL PUSH-UPS

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your abs.
Inhale when bending your arms, and exhale when stretching them out.
To make it harder, perform a traditional push-up on the floor.
This exercise primarily targets your chest and arms.

introduce: Stand in front of a wall with your hands against the wall. Slowly step back and slide your hands down until your upper body is parallel to the floor. \n\nPush your hands forward into the wall as you pull your hips away from the wall. Transfer your weight into your feet. Hold this position.
name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG ON THE WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please put your feet under your hips to feel more stretch.
Take deep and steady breaths.
This exercise can elongate your spine and stretch your shoulders and legs.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Straighten your arms up towards the ceiling.

Open your knees while extending your arms out to the sides, keeping your chest wide.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL BUTTERFLY WITH CHEST OPENER

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Inhale as you open your knees, and exhale as you bring them together.
It strengthens hip abductors.
It helps improve hip flexibility and stretches the inner thighs.
It develops stronger chest and arm muscles.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall. Extend your arms to the sides.

Twist your legs to the left while keeping your upper body in place and your knees and feet together.

Hold it for one second, then return and twist to the other side. Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL SUPINE WINDSHIELD WIPERS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Breathe steadily throughout.
Avoid rotating your legs to the point where your opposite arm can no longer stay on the floor.
Keep your abs tightened during the entire exercise.
This exercise stretches the lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides.

Lift your upper body off the ground with arms extended parallel to the ground.

Come back down and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL ABDOMINAL CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your neck in a neutral position by avoiding any forward tilting.
Keep your chin slightly tucked towards your chest.
Avoid using your arms to propel your body upwards.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
Exhale when lifting, and inhale when lowering.
It's a good exercise for your abs.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Put your arms straight over the top of your head.

Lift your upper body off the floor, then slowly go back to the starting position.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL LONG ARM CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your neck in a neutral position by avoiding any forward tilting.
Keep your chin slightly tucked towards your chest.
Avoid using your arms to propel your body upwards.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
Exhale when lifting, and inhale when lowering.
The exercise increases abdominal endurance.

introduce:
Lift into a plank position, with your hands crossed on the floor. Bend your legs against the wall with knees on the floor.

Lift your hips up towards your feet, while maintaining the plank position with your upper body. Then, lower your hips.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL KNEE PLANK & HIP EXTENSION

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your hands crossed firmly on the floor to stabilize your upper body.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Put your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Inhale as you lower, exhale as you lift your hips.
It strengthens the glutes and abs.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall at arm's length. Press your right hand firmly into the wall for support.

Stretch your upper body sideways towards the wall, lifting your left arm overhead. Hold this position for 15 seconds.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL STANDING SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core muscles.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Breathe regularly.
Keep your supporting arm stable or stretch it gently when needed.
This workout stretches the spine and side abs.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall at arm's length. Press your left hand firmly into the wall for support.

Stretch your upper body sideways towards the wall, lifting your right arm overhead. Hold this position for 15 seconds.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL STANDING SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core muscles.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Breathe regularly.
Keep your supporting arm stable or stretch it gently when needed.
This workout stretches the spine and side abs.

introduce:
Stand with your back against the wall and feet hip-width apart. Extend your arms forward at shoulder height, palms facing each other.

Extend your arms as far out as possible, then move them back to the front.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL DYNAMIC CHEST

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Move your arms as far back as possible.
You can gradually increase the speed.
Inhale as you open your arms, and exhale as you bring them back together.
This exercise stretches your chest and shoulders.

introduce:
Stand with your back against the wall, feet hip-width apart, and arms by your sides.

Drop your head down and slowly roll your spine down from the wall, segment by segment. Reach your hands towards the floor.

Roll back up to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL STANDING ROLL DOWN

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears.
Engage your core muscles.
Feel your back muscles lengthening as you descend.
Exhale as you roll down from the wall, and inhale as you roll back.
It stretches the back muscles.
It promotes spinal mobility.

introduce:
Start in a kneeling plank position. Place your forearms on the ground, parallel to the wall. Bend your legs against the wall with knees on the floor.

Rotate your upper body, while extending one arm up.

Return to the starting position, switch sides, and repeat it.
name: WALL KNEELING ELBOW PLANK ROTATION

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Inhale when you rotate your body up, and exhale when you return.
This exercise works on your middle deltoid and core.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall and press your right forearm against it. Align your right elbow with your shoulder. Take a big step away from the wall and reach your left arm up.

Rotate your upper body to the right until your left hand touches the right waist.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL STANDING THORACIC LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Avoid using momentum to twist the body.
Exhale as you rotate your upper body, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
It promotes the flexibility of the thoracic spine and abdominal strength.

introduce:
Stand sideways to the wall and press your left forearm against it. Align your left elbow with your shoulder. Take a big step away from the wall and reach your right arm up.

Rotate your upper body to the left until your right hand touches the left waist.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL STANDING THORACIC RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Avoid using momentum to twist the body.
Exhale as you rotate your upper body, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
It promotes the flexibility of the thoracic spine and abdominal strength.

introduce:
Sit facing a wall with your legs bent and toes touching where the wall meets the floor. Lean back slightly, supporting yourself with both hands on the floor.

Engage your abs to lift your upper body towards the ceiling, then slightly round your back.

Repeat it.
name: WALL ABDOMINAL ROLL BACK AND FORTH

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your upper body.
Avoid relying solely on your arms for support.
You should feel your abs pulling in.
Inhale as you lift your upper body, and exhale as you round your back.
It primarily strengthens the abs.

introduce:
Sit facing a wall with your legs bent and toes touching where the wall meets the floor. Lean back slightly, supporting yourself with both hands on the floor.

Lift one foot, bringing your toes to tap the wall. Return and lift the other foot to tap the wall.

Repeat it.
name: WALL TOE TAP

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight.
Keep your neck relaxed and in a neutral position.
Exhale as you tap your foot, and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
This exercise works on your abs.
